structures.name: Hero + Features + CTA
structures.cta_placement: Hero (sticky) + Bottom
structures.color_strategy: Hero: Brand primary or vibrant. Features: Card bg #FAFAFA. CTA: Contrasting accent color
structures.notes: Deep CTA placement. For CTA label text, verify at least 4.5:1 against the button fill; use 7:1 only when the product explicitly targets AAA normal-text contrast.

structures.name: Hero + Testimonials + CTA
structures.cta_placement: Hero (sticky) + Post-testimonials
structures.color_strategy: Hero: Brand color. Testimonials: Light bg #F5F5F5. Quotes: Italic, muted color #666. CTA: Vibrant
structures.notes: Social proof before CTA. Use a concise set of verified testimonials with photo, name, and role.

structures.name: Product Demo + Features
structures.cta_placement: Video center + CTA right/bottom
structures.color_strategy: Video surround: Brand color overlay. Features: Icon color #0080FF. Text: Dark #222
structures.notes: Use an interactive demo only when it explains value better than static media. Provide captions, transcript, visible play/pause controls, and a non-video fallback; do not autoplay under reduced motion.

structures.name: Minimal Single Column
structures.cta_placement: Center, large CTA button
structures.color_strategy: Minimalist: Brand + white #FFFFFF + accent. Verify CTA label text against its button fill at 4.5:1 minimum; use 7:1 only for an explicit AAA normal-text target.
structures.notes: Single CTA focus. Large typography.

structures.name: Funnel (3-Step Conversion)
structures.cta_placement: Each step: mini-CTA. Final: main CTA
structures.color_strategy: Step colors: 1 (Red/Problem), 2 (Orange/Process), 3 (Green/Solution). CTA: Brand color
structures.notes: Progressive disclosure. Show only essential info per step.

structures.name: Comparison Table + CTA
structures.cta_placement: Table: Right column. CTA: Below table
structures.color_strategy: Table: Alternating rows (white/light grey). Your product: Highlight #FFFACD (light yellow) or green. Text: Dark
structures.notes: Use comparison to show unique value. Highlight your product row.

structures.name: Lead Magnet + Form
sections: Lead magnet preview (ebook cover, checklist, etc)
structures.cta_placement: Form CTA: Submit button
structures.color_strategy: Lead magnet: Professional design. Form: Clean white bg. Inputs: Light border #CCCCCC. CTA: Brand color
structures.notes: Ask only for information necessary to deliver the lead magnet. Preview its value and show submission progress.

structures.name: Pricing Page + CTA
structures.cta_placement: Each card: CTA button. Sticky CTA in nav
structures.color_strategy: Free: Grey, Starter: Blue, Pro: Green/Gold, Enterprise: Dark. Cards: 1px border, shadow
structures.notes: Highlight the plan that matches the intended audience and show actual annual savings transparently. Use FAQs to address concerns.

structures.name: Video-First Hero
structures.cta_placement: Overlay on video (center/bottom) + Bottom section
structures.color_strategy: Use an overlay strong enough for text contrast. Brand accent for CTA. Light text only when the measured contrast passes.
structures.notes: Use video only when it demonstrates value better than static media. Add captions for accessibility.

structures.name: Scroll-Triggered Storytelling
structures.cta_placement: End of each chapter (mini) + Final climax CTA
structures.color_strategy: Progressive reveal. Each chapter has distinct color. Building intensity.
structures.notes: Keep the narrative understandable without scroll-driven effects. Use progress indicator.

structures.name: Waitlist/Coming Soon
structures.cta_placement: Email form prominent (above fold) + Sticky form on scroll
structures.color_strategy: Anticipation: Dark + accent highlights. Countdown in brand color. Urgency indicators.
structures.notes: Explain early-access benefits without fabricated scarcity. Show a waitlist count only when it is current, verified, and dated.

structures.name: Comparison Table Focus
structures.cta_placement: After comparison table (highlighted row) + Bottom
structures.color_strategy: Your product column highlighted (accent bg or green). Competitors neutral. Checkmarks green.
structures.notes: Show value vs competitors. Measure comparison performance with product-specific analytics.

structures.name: Pricing-Focused Landing
structures.cta_placement: Each pricing card + Sticky CTA in nav + Bottom
structures.color_strategy: Popular plan highlighted (brand color border/bg). Free: grey. Enterprise: dark/premium.
structures.notes: Show actual monthly and annual totals and savings transparently. Explain plan differences and address objections in the FAQ.

structures.name: App Store Style Landing
structures.cta_placement: Download buttons prominent (App Store + Play Store) throughout
structures.color_strategy: Dark/light matching app store feel. Star ratings in gold. Screenshots with device frames.
structures.notes: Show real screenshots and only current verified ratings. Provide platform-specific CTAs, buttons and keyboard controls in addition to swipe, and pause any auto-rotation.

structures.name: FAQ/Documentation Landing
structures.cta_placement: Search bar prominent + Contact CTA for unresolved questions
structures.color_strategy: Clean, high readability. Minimal color. Category icons in brand color. Success green for resolved.
structures.notes: Reduce support tickets. Track search analytics.

structures.name: Event/Conference Landing
structures.cta_placement: Register CTA sticky + After speakers + Bottom
structures.color_strategy: Urgency colors (countdown). Event branding. Speaker cards professional. Sponsor logos neutral.
structures.notes: Early bird pricing with deadline. Social proof (past attendees).

structures.name: Product Review/Ratings Focused
structures.cta_placement: After reviews summary + Buy button alongside reviews
structures.color_strategy: Trust colors. Star ratings gold. Verified badge green. Review sentiment colors.
structures.notes: User-generated content builds trust. Show verified purchases.

structures.name: Community/Forum Landing
structures.cta_placement: Join button prominent + After member showcase
structures.color_strategy: Warm, welcoming. Member photos add humanity. Topic badges in brand colors. Activity indicators green.
structures.notes: Preview real community value and simplify onboarding. Show member and activity counts only when current, verified, and dated; label activity as live only when backed by an active real-time source.

structures.name: Before-After Transformation
structures.cta_placement: After transformation reveal + Bottom
structures.color_strategy: Contrast: muted/grey (before) vs vibrant/colorful (after). Success green for results.
structures.notes: Visual proof of value. Measure the outcome with product-specific analytics.

structures.name: Marketplace / Directory
structures.cta_placement: Hero Search Bar + Navbar 'List your item'
structures.color_strategy: Search: High contrast. Categories: Visual icons. Trust: Blue/Green.
structures.notes: Search is the primary CTA. Reduce friction with useful suggestions.

structures.name: Newsletter / Content First
structures.cta_placement: Hero inline form + Sticky header form
structures.color_strategy: Minimalist. Paper-like background. Text focus. Accent color for Subscribe.
structures.notes: Keep the form to the fields actually required and link to a sample issue. Show a subscriber count only when it is current, verified, and dated; otherwise use qualitative social proof.

structures.name: Webinar Registration
structures.cta_placement: Hero (Right side form) + Bottom anchor
structures.color_strategy: Urgency: Red/Orange. Professional: Blue/Navy. Form: High contrast white.
structures.notes: State the event time and timezone in text. Claim limited seats or live status only when current capacity or stream state is verified and timestamped.

structures.name: Enterprise Gateway
structures.cta_placement: Contact Sales (Primary) + Login (Secondary)
structures.color_strategy: Corporate: Navy/Grey. High integrity. Conservative accents.
structures.notes: Path selection (I am a...). Mega menu navigation.

structures.name: Portfolio Grid
structures.cta_placement: Project Card Hover + Footer Contact
structures.color_strategy: Neutral background (let work shine). Text: Black/White. Accent: Minimal.
structures.notes: Visuals first. Filter by category.

structures.name: Bento Grid Showcase
structures.cta_placement: Floating Action Button or Bottom of Grid
structures.color_strategy: Card backgrounds: #F5F5F7 or Glass. Icons: Vibrant brand colors. Text: Dark.
structures.notes: Scannable value props. High information density without clutter.

structures.name: Feature-Rich Showcase
structures.cta_placement: Hero (sticky) + After features + Bottom
structures.color_strategy: Brand primary + card bg #FAFAFA. Feature icons accent. CTA contrasting.
structures.notes: Clear feature hierarchy. One key message per card.

structures.name: Hero-Centric Design
structures.cta_placement: Hero dominant (center/bottom) + Sticky nav CTA
structures.color_strategy: Hero: High-impact visual. Minimal text. Verify CTA label text against the button fill at 4.5:1 minimum; use 7:1 only for an explicit AAA normal-text target.
structures.notes: One primary CTA. Let the hero dominate the initial viewport without hiding the next content cue.

structures.name: Trust & Authority + Conversion
structures.cta_placement: Contact Sales / Get Quote (primary) + Nav
structures.color_strategy: Navy/Grey corporate. Trust blue. Accent for CTA only.
structures.notes: Security badges. Case studies.

structures.name: Real-Time / Operations Landing
structures.cta_placement: Primary CTA in nav + After metrics
structures.color_strategy: Dark or neutral. Status colors (green/amber/red). Data-dense but scannable.
structures.notes: Offer a demo or sandbox and show trust signals. Label telemetry as live only when backed by a current source, with update time and stale state.
